主要内容: On June 19, 2012, Walgreen Co. issued a press release announcing its financial results for the quarter ended May 31, 2012. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. Walgreen Co. and Alliance Boots are conducting a conference call and webcast regarding the Purchase and Option Agreement, while Walgreen Co. is also holding a separate conference call and webcast to discuss its financial results. The slides for these calls are available on the Walgreens investor relations website. The company also issued a joint press release with Alliance Boots regarding the entry into a Purchase and Option Agreement. This Form 8-K filing from Walgreen Co. and Alliance Boots on June 19, 2012, outlines the joint press release related to their business activities. The document includes a cautionary note regarding forward-looking statements, which are subject to various risks and uncertainties. These statements include the ability to satisfy closing conditions, consummate transactions, and achieve anticipated financial results. The filing also references the risks associated with international operations, governance, and financing arrangements. The press release is incorporated by reference into Item 8.01 and includes Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2. The document serves as a disclosure of potential future outcomes and highlights the uncertainties that could affect the company's performance.
